CompositionGroup.description:
A simplex (sum-to-1) covariate set encoded by additive log-ratio (ALR).

Every proportion/probability vector has one redundant part; ALR drops the
``reference`` (default: last column) and emits ``K - 1`` log-ratio coordinates.
Operators declare one group per composition (e.g. cell fractions); parts must
be disjoint across groups and from numeric/ordinal/categorical roles.

columns.description: Ordered simplex parts (K >= 2); values are closed to sum 1 before ALR.
columns.title: Columns

pseudocount.description: Numerical guard added before the log-ratio. Required per group when composition ALR runs; set in profile/site actionConfig (no code default).
pseudocount.title: Pseudocount

reference.description: ALR denominator part; defaults to the last column when unset.
reference.title: Reference

standardize.description: Z-score the ALR coordinates (default true). ALR coords are unbounded.
standardize.title: Standardize

CompositionGroup.title: CompositionGroup

locked_test.description: Sample paths reserved as locked test (never used for tuning).
locked_test.title: Locked Test

pivotal_validation.description: Sample paths reserved for pivotal/clinical validation.
pivotal_validation.title: Pivotal Validation

post_market_monitoring.description: Optional sample paths used for post-market monitoring analyses.
post_market_monitoring.title: Post Market Monitoring

ValidationPartitionContract.title: ValidationPartitionContract

abort_on_step_failure.description: If True, abort all iterations when a pipeline step fails; if False, skip the iteration.
abort_on_step_failure.title: Abort On Step Failure

backend_profiles.description: Typed backend profile registry. Runtime backend config is resolved exclusively from this field.

biological_review_confirmed.description: After review, set True in step_config.validation to allow --model (classifier + predictor).
biological_review_confirmed.title: Biological Review Confirmed

dmp_featurecuts_fail_if_below_target.description: Strict DMP FC: exclude iteration when BA target unmet or panel below min_dmps (do not expand into worse BA).
dmp_featurecuts_fail_if_below_target.title: Dmp Featurecuts Fail If Below Target

dmp_featurecuts_max_dmps.description: Upper cap on DMP FeatureCuts k-search / export.
dmp_featurecuts_max_dmps.title: Dmp Featurecuts Max Dmps

dmp_featurecuts_min_dmps.description: Minimum DMP panel size after FC; fail/exclude run when unmet (no BA-diluting expansion).
dmp_featurecuts_min_dmps.title: Dmp Featurecuts Min Dmps

dmp_featurecuts_target_ba.description: Held-out BA gate for DMP FeatureCuts (separate from gene FC).
dmp_featurecuts_target_ba.title: Dmp Featurecuts Target Ba

dmp_modeling_mode.description: Statistical DMP axis: raw_pool (discovery only), featurecuts (BA-gated panel), or stable_panel (frozen consensus from prior phase). Seeds legacy stability flags when set.
dmp_modeling_mode.title: Dmp Modeling Mode

enforce_training_analyte_match.description: If True, --model fails when step_config.validation.regulatory training analyte does not match locked_model_spec.json (blocks buffy-trained model on cfDNA projects).
enforce_training_analyte_match.title: Enforce Training Analyte Match

freeze_gene_importance_min.description: Optional lower bound on gene_importance when building freeze-time fixed_gene_panel.
freeze_gene_importance_min.title: Freeze Gene Importance Min

freeze_min_dmps_per_feature.description: Minimum number of unique frozen DMPs required for a gene×region panel row (union over isoform/GTF intervals) to be included in freeze-time fixed_gene_features output.
freeze_min_dmps_per_feature.title: Freeze Min Dmps Per Feature

freeze_stable_gene_csv.description: Path to stable_genes_production.csv for freeze gene-axis wiring (default: monte_carlo_runs/stability/stable_genes_production.csv when present).
freeze_stable_gene_csv.title: Freeze Stable Gene Csv

freeze_top_genes.description: Optional cap per comparison for top-ranked genes in freeze-time fixed_gene_panel.
freeze_top_genes.title: Freeze Top Genes

frozen_project_path.description: project.json from --freeze production build; merged into each run for predictor_only mode.
frozen_project_path.title: Frozen Project Path

gene_featurecuts_loci_source.description: Loci fed into gene FC: raw_pool (discovery), featurecuts_selected (classifier), or stable_panel (Phase B two-stage workflows).
gene_featurecuts_loci_source.title: Gene Featurecuts Loci Source

gene_featurecuts_max_genes.description: Cap ranked mapper gene pool before gene FC k-search.
gene_featurecuts_max_genes.title: Gene Featurecuts Max Genes

gene_featurecuts_min_genes.description: Minimum gene panel size after gene FC (alias for stability_min_selected_genes).
gene_featurecuts_min_genes.title: Gene Featurecuts Min Genes

gene_featurecuts_target_ba.description: Held-out BA gate for gene FeatureCuts (separate from DMP FC).
gene_featurecuts_target_ba.title: Gene Featurecuts Target Ba

gene_modeling_mode.description: Statistical gene axis: none, mapper_ranked (annotation stability), featurecuts (BA-gated gene panel), or from_stable_dmp_panel (map stable loci then optional gene FC).
gene_modeling_mode.title: Gene Modeling Mode

holdout_ci.description: Two-sided confidence level for bootstrap intervals on hold-out QC metrics.
holdout_ci.title: Holdout Ci

holdout_eval.description: If True, run the true held-out batch evaluation (Workflow 3): score a frozen model on a designated hold-out partition (never used for training/selection) and bootstrap the QC metric distributions. Requires frozen_project_path (or the default monte_carlo_runs/production/project.json) and a populated validation_partitions hold-out role.
holdout_eval.title: Holdout Eval

holdout_exclude_from_training.description: Preflight guard: fail --holdout-eval if hold-out samples also appear in the frozen model's training cohorts, which would invalidate the held-out claim.
holdout_exclude_from_training.title: Holdout Exclude From Training

holdout_n_bootstrap.description: Number of bootstrap resamples used to characterize hold-out QC metric distributions.
holdout_n_bootstrap.title: Holdout N Bootstrap

holdout_partition.description: Which validation_partitions role provides the held-out batch samples for --holdout-eval (e.g. locked_test, pivotal_validation, post_market_monitoring).
holdout_partition.title: Holdout Partition

holdout_seed.description: Random seed for hold-out bootstrap resampling (None = nondeterministic).
holdout_seed.title: Holdout Seed

holdout_stratified.description: Resample within each class (stratified bootstrap) so class proportions are preserved.
holdout_stratified.title: Holdout Stratified

min_sensitivity_lcb.description: Optional minimum lower confidence bound acceptance criterion for sensitivity.
min_sensitivity_lcb.title: Min Sensitivity Lcb

min_specificity_lcb.description: Optional minimum lower confidence bound acceptance criterion for specificity.
min_specificity_lcb.title: Min Specificity Lcb

parallel_mc_centroid_seed.description: When true (default), plan a shared per-group centroid seed and cohort-relative iteration deltas so MC iterations can run in parallel. Set false for legacy sequential iteration chaining.
parallel_mc_centroid_seed.title: Parallel Mc Centroid Seed

path_remap.description: Optional prefix remap (old -> new) for path strings in project JSON (e.g. samples_base_path, paths to cohort list files). User cohort CSVs and MV training_*.csv use basenames only; MV testing_*.csv uses absolute paths in a path column and is rewritten during --freeze when needed. Bases like samples_base_path must match the machine. Put under step_config.validation in the project JSON, or pass --path-remap OLD=NEW.
path_remap.title: Path Remap

predictor_only.description: If True, each iteration only runs methyl-predictor (no centroid/detector/classifier). Requires frozen_project_path (or default monte_carlo_runs/production/project.json) so model paths resolve to the frozen build.
predictor_only.title: Predictor Only

production_output_dir.description: Output directory for the final production run (defaults to monte_carlo_runs/production).
production_output_dir.title: Production Output Dir

regulatory.description: Lifecycle-stage framing and claim-boundary metadata for FDA-oriented reporting.

require_biological_review_for_model.description: If True, methyl-validation --model exits unless biological_review_confirmed is true (set in step_config.validation after expert review).
require_biological_review_for_model.title: Require Biological Review For Model

require_complete_enricher.description: If True, readiness audit treats incomplete enricher_completeness.json as no_go (not only a warning).
require_complete_enricher.title: Require Complete Enricher

rollout_balanced_accuracy_drop_max.description: Dual-run promotion guard: max allowed BA drop vs baseline.
rollout_balanced_accuracy_drop_max.title: Rollout Balanced Accuracy Drop Max

rollout_brier_improvement_min_frac.description: Dual-run promotion target: minimum relative Brier improvement.
rollout_brier_improvement_min_frac.title: Rollout Brier Improvement Min Frac

rollout_ece_improvement_min_frac.description: Dual-run promotion target: minimum relative ECE improvement.
rollout_ece_improvement_min_frac.title: Rollout Ece Improvement Min Frac

rollout_macro_f1_drop_max.description: Dual-run promotion guard: max allowed macro-F1 drop vs baseline.
rollout_macro_f1_drop_max.title: Rollout Macro F1 Drop Max

rollout_nll_improvement_min_frac.description: Dual-run promotion target: minimum relative NLL improvement.
rollout_nll_improvement_min_frac.title: Rollout Nll Improvement Min Frac

run_stability.description: If True, run stability analysis on discovery DMPs after the main loop (gene stability only if enricher ran).
run_stability.title: Run Stability

stability_classifier_export_margin_abs.description: MC detector override: extra top-ranked DMPs in extended classifier CSV beyond k_core.
stability_classifier_export_margin_abs.title: Stability Classifier Export Margin Abs

stability_classifier_export_margin_pct.description: MC detector override: extended classifier CSV margin as a fraction above k_core.
stability_classifier_export_margin_pct.title: Stability Classifier Export Margin Pct

stability_classifier_export_max_dmps.description: MC detector override: per-chromosome cap on extended classifier CSV size.
stability_classifier_export_max_dmps.title: Stability Classifier Export Max Dmps

stability_convergence_jaccard.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity required between current and lagged stable DMP panels.
stability_convergence_jaccard.title: Stability Convergence Jaccard

stability_convergence_max_size_delta.description: Maximum allowed relative panel-size change between current and lagged stable DMP panels.
stability_convergence_max_size_delta.title: Stability Convergence Max Size Delta

stability_convergence_patience.description: Number of consecutive convergence checkpoints that must pass before stopping early.
stability_convergence_patience.title: Stability Convergence Patience

stability_convergence_window.description: Window size (in qualifying runs) for comparing stable panels S_k vs S_(k-window).
stability_convergence_window.title: Stability Convergence Window

stability_default_freeze_tier.description: Tier whose stable_dmps_production.csv is aliased to root stability/stable_dmps_production.csv for default --freeze behavior.
stability_default_freeze_tier.title: Stability Default Freeze Tier

stability_dmp_freq.description: Minimum frequency (across runs) for a DMP to be considered stable. Set to 0.0 when DMP FeatureCuts is off (dmp_modeling_mode=raw_pool) so stability emits the union discovery locus pool for gene mapping — not a recurrence-filtered DMP biomarker panel (see dmp_panel_role in stability_summary).
stability_dmp_freq.title: Stability Dmp Freq

stability_dual_cutoff_enabled.description: If true, stability outputs both strict and relaxed stable DMP panels using score = effect_size * sqrt(frequency) with log-score elbow cutoff.
stability_dual_cutoff_enabled.title: Stability Dual Cutoff Enabled

stability_early_stop_enabled.description: If true, evaluate convergence of stable DMP panels during the MC loop and stop early when convergence thresholds hold for the configured patience.
stability_early_stop_enabled.title: Stability Early Stop Enabled

stability_featurecuts_enabled.description: If true, MC detector runs force classifier_dmp_selection=featurecuts_validation so stability can be computed from discriminatory classifier panels.
stability_featurecuts_enabled.title: Stability Featurecuts Enabled

stability_gene_biomarker_filter_enabled.description: If true, apply in-process disease CSV filters and optional STRING PPI hub ranking to narrow the gene pool before MC gene FeatureCuts (no full methyl-enricher step).
stability_gene_biomarker_filter_enabled.title: Stability Gene Biomarker Filter Enabled

stability_gene_biomarker_min_degree.description: Drop PPI nodes with degree below this threshold (0 keeps all nodes).
stability_gene_biomarker_min_degree.title: Stability Gene Biomarker Min Degree

stability_gene_biomarker_mode.description: Biomarker gene pool mode: disease_only (CSV filters only), ppi_only or disease_and_ppi (disease filters then STRING PPI hub ranking).
stability_gene_biomarker_mode.title: Stability Gene Biomarker Mode

stability_gene_biomarker_ppi_cache_path.description: STRING edge cache directory or file for MC biomarker PPI. Defaults to step_config.enricher.network_refinement.cache_path.
stability_gene_biomarker_ppi_cache_path.title: Stability Gene Biomarker Ppi Cache Path

stability_gene_biomarker_ppi_top_hubs.description: Max PPI hub genes passed to gene FeatureCuts pool.
stability_gene_biomarker_ppi_top_hubs.title: Stability Gene Biomarker Ppi Top Hubs

stability_gene_biomarker_top_genes.description: Cap genes entering PPI fetch after disease CSV filters (mirrors enricher top).
stability_gene_biomarker_top_genes.title: Stability Gene Biomarker Top Genes

stability_gene_featurecuts_dmp_source.description: DMP CSV layer used to build gene FeatureCuts features. 'discovery' maps all biologically filtered loci to genes (recommended for discovery_gene_featurecuts). 'classifier' uses FeatureCuts-selected DMP panels only. 'stable' uses a frozen stable DMP panel CSV (two-phase mode 5).
stability_gene_featurecuts_dmp_source.title: Stability Gene Featurecuts Dmp Source

stability_gene_featurecuts_enabled.description: If true, each MC iteration runs methyl-mapper then gene FeatureCuts (ECDF OvR k-search) after detector, and stability aggregates stable genes from genes-classifier exports.
stability_gene_featurecuts_enabled.title: Stability Gene Featurecuts Enabled

stability_gene_featurecuts_max_dmps.description: Genome-wide cap on DMP loci used for MC gene FeatureCuts (after deduplication). Set in site manifest or profile actionConfig.validation (not in code).
stability_gene_featurecuts_max_dmps.title: Stability Gene Featurecuts Max Dmps

stability_gene_featurecuts_max_genes.description: Cap the ranked mapper gene pool before MC gene FeatureCuts k-search. Set in site manifest or profile actionConfig.validation (not in code).
stability_gene_featurecuts_max_genes.title: Stability Gene Featurecuts Max Genes

stability_gene_freq.description: Minimum frequency for a gene to be considered stable. When stability_gene_featurecuts_enabled, counts genes from per-run classifier gene panels.
stability_gene_freq.title: Stability Gene Freq

stability_gene_recurrence_source.description: Gene stability aggregation source. For gene FeatureCuts packs use 'classifier' (genes-classifier.csv from methyl-mapper + FeatureCuts). 'mapper' uses mapper-ranked gene tables. 'enricher' is for enricher-hub recurrence only — disease enrichment is usually applied at freeze, not as the MC gene-recurrence source for gene FeatureCuts.
stability_gene_recurrence_source.title: Stability Gene Recurrence Source

stability_gene_region_hits.description: Optional region tokens (promoter, exon, intron, gene_body, terminator). Require corresponding mapper hits_* > 0 before biomarker filtering.
stability_gene_region_hits.title: Stability Gene Region Hits

stability_mapper_enrich_disease.description: When true, MC methyl-mapper iterations run Grok/OpenTargets disease enrichment. Default false for speed; production --freeze mapper uses project step_config.mapper.enrich_disease.
stability_mapper_enrich_disease.title: Stability Mapper Enrich Disease

stability_min_balanced_accuracy.description: If set, stability counts DMPs only from iterations whose validation_metrics.json balanced_accuracy is >= this value. Frequencies are over those qualifying runs only. Requires DMP or gene FeatureCuts (dmp_modeling_mode=featurecuts and/or gene_modeling_mode=featurecuts|from_stable_dmp_panel); without FeatureCuts per-run balanced_accuracy is unavailable.
stability_min_balanced_accuracy.title: Stability Min Balanced Accuracy

stability_min_core_dmps.description: Optional small guardrail on detector k_core during MC FeatureCuts (passed to detector min_core_dmps).
stability_min_core_dmps.title: Stability Min Core Dmps

stability_min_iterations.description: Minimum number of qualifying runs required before stability convergence checks can trigger.
stability_min_iterations.title: Stability Min Iterations

stability_min_selected_genes.description: Optional lower bound for gene classifier panel size in gene FeatureCuts mode. Final selected k is max(featurecuts_k, stability_min_selected_genes).
stability_min_selected_genes.title: Stability Min Selected Genes

stability_relaxed_cutoff_mode.description: How to derive relaxed stability cutoff when dual-cutoff is enabled: elbow_log_score (second elbow in tail) or strict_multiplier.
stability_relaxed_cutoff_mode.title: Stability Relaxed Cutoff Mode

stability_relaxed_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to strict score threshold when stability_relaxed_cutoff_mode='strict_multiplier'.
stability_relaxed_multiplier.title: Stability Relaxed Multiplier

stability_score_eps.description: Small epsilon used in log(score + eps) elbow detection.
stability_score_eps.title: Stability Score Eps

stability_target_balanced_accuracy.description: Optional target BA for detector FeatureCuts: choose minimum top-k DMPs that reach this BA on detector validation splits. Also enables binary-search k selection in MC gene FeatureCuts.
stability_target_balanced_accuracy.title: Stability Target Balanced Accuracy

stability_tier_core_freq.description: Core tier threshold for frequency-based stability.
stability_tier_core_freq.title: Stability Tier Core Freq

stability_tier_exploratory_freq.description: Exploratory tier threshold for frequency-based stability.
stability_tier_exploratory_freq.title: Stability Tier Exploratory Freq

stability_tier_extended_freq.description: Extended tier threshold for frequency-based stability.
stability_tier_extended_freq.title: Stability Tier Extended Freq

stability_tiers_enabled.description: If true, write three tiered stability outputs under stability/tier_core, stability/tier_extended, stability/tier_exploratory.
stability_tiers_enabled.title: Stability Tiers Enabled

subgroup_columns.description: Optional metadata columns for subgroup reporting in clinical performance reports (e.g., sex, age_bin, site_id, race_ethnicity).
subgroup_columns.title: Subgroup Columns

train_fraction.description: Fraction of samples used for training per cohort (e.g. 0.8).
train_fraction.title: Train Fraction
